# U1 SDK current source preparation final report

Status: DONE for source preparation. This is not full U1/MVP delivery.

## Candidate identity

- Issue: `746dd7b`
- Worker: `gcm-u1-sdk-current-prep`
- Worktree: `/Volumes/Intel/playground/agentteams/u1-sdk-current-prep-20261005`
- Branch: `codex/u1-sdk-current-prep-20261005`
- Base/HEAD: `9a95b63f3b44d7eb7f5cf4f53e40743b2f3bce0a`
- Source state: staged delta, no unstaged tracked changes

## Scope and actual delta

The staged candidate contains exactly the allowed 13 paths:

```text
.appsdk/guidance/compiled.json
.appsdk/project.json
cli/package-install.spec.ts
docs/architecture/function-map.json
docs/architecture/mainline-call-map.json
docs/architecture/verification-map.json
docs/evidence/746dd7b-sdk-final-pack-20261004/notes.md
package.json
scripts/artifact-smoke.mjs
scripts/installed-runtime-smoke.mjs
scripts/package-artifact.mjs
scripts/package-sdk-smoke.mjs
tsconfig.runtime.json
```

No product source was changed in this preparation step. The parent applied the frozen unit and staged it; I verified the composition and reused the staged changes.

Wiring verified:

- `scripts/package-artifact.mjs` is the sole package producer.
- Final mode calls the existing `runtime/dagpipe/build.mjs` `buildRunner()` entry once.
- Final mode stages the compiled `runtime/dagpipe/host.js` and `protocol.js`, the runner, manifest, and five Work graphs.
- `runtime/dagpipe/runner/src/bin/runner.rs` registers the ten Operators used by `agent-work@2`, `work-open@1`, `work-request@1`, `work-close@1`, and `work-query@1`.
- `.appsdk/project.json` binds the compiled host/protocol, transitive control-protocol/network runtime modules, runner, manifest, and five graph outputs.
- `docs/architecture/function-map.json`, `mainline-call-map.json`, and `verification-map.json` bind the final package path and keep `release_eligible=false`.
- The new host continuation fix removes `policyRevision` only for `work-request`; the one-shot `agent-work` path still requires and uses it. The staged smoke is compatible.

No combination error was found, so there is no product diff beyond the parent-applied frozen unit.

## Commands and exits

All raw logs are in `/Users/fanzhang/.codex/task-evidence/agentteams/receipts/u1-sdk-current-prep-20261005/`.

| Command | Exit | Evidence |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `pnpm typecheck` | 0 | `typecheck.log` |
| `pnpm build` | 0 | `build.log` |
| `node -e ... buildRunner()` | 0 | `runner-build.log` |
| `dagpipe graph validate` for all five graphs | 0 | `graph-validate.log` |
| `appsdk guide compile` | 0 | `guide-compile.log` |
| `git diff --cached --check` | 0 | terminal result recorded in `run-notes.md` |

- Receipt protocol: `teams-dagpipe-runner-build-receipt`

- Graph hashes matched the current five graph sources.

## Reused, run, and not run

Reused as source input:

- The parent-applied frozen 13-path delta.
- Historical source/package evidence in `docs/evidence/746dd7b-sdk-final-pack-20261004/notes.md` and the old candidate receipt.

Run in this preparation step:

- `pnpm typecheck`
- `pnpm build`
- Real `buildRunner()` entry
- Five `dagpipe graph validate` commands
- `appsdk guide compile`

Not run by design:

- `scripts/package-sdk-smoke.mjs` and installed lifecycle/CLI/launcher/ps-dependent black-box tests

- Review, admission, integration, commit, merge, push, memory, and cleanup

The primary owns these gates after candidate freeze. Old installed evidence does not prove the current final package.

## Open obligations

- Current final package source-level candidate is prepared, but no current installed SDK/consumer receipt exists for this SHA.
- The primary must freeze the candidate, rebuild the package, run the current installed SDK/consumer and affected public-entry tests, then run the official gate and independent review.
- `docs/architecture/resource-map.json:14` is outside the allowed write set and still has stale wording that final mode includes "two graphs" and that the package is not present. The staged producer and package paths use five graphs. The primary should reconcile this map text during integration if that file remains authoritative.
- Do not claim full U1/MVP, review PASS, admission, or delivery for this source-preparation result.
